blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – A soldier wounded in Thursday night’s ambush in Lamitan City, Basilan, died early Friday morning, a military official confirmed. Brig. Gen. Frederick Sales, commander of the Philippine Army’s 1101st Infantry Brigade, told the Inquirer that the victim succumbed to severe head injuries at around dawn on Friday. The ambush, which took place around 6:55 p.m. on Thursday in Barangay Sabong, Lamitan City, targeted troops from the 45th Infantry Battalion (IB) returning to their base in a 6×6 KM45 military truck after picking up personnel at a local port.
